q: Did CEA version 22.0 change the grid factors for earlier years?
title: CEA version 21.0 vs 22.0: past-year revisions
short: No, not at the published precision. The FY 2024-25 weighted average stays at 0.710 t CO2 per MWh in both versions, the combined margin stays at 0.736, and FY 2021-22 to FY 2023-24 are also unchanged. Version 22.0 adds FY 2025-26 at 0.675, so past footprints need no restating.
audience: Companies that already reported FY 2024-25 or earlier Scope 2 on a CEA factor

sections.h: Weighted average, t CO2 per MWh

p: Version 22.0 recalculated FY 2024-25 with actual captive power data, but the rounded figures CEA publishes did not move. If you reported FY 2024-25 at 0.710, there is nothing to restate.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into dated kWh records per meter and site, so whichever CEA factor and version you apply, each Scope 2 figure traces back to the bill and the factor behind it.
